name_reason: The 'tutorial_progress' framing is a misnomer. xrefs to the counter [0x540FE] are all 5 internal to this function (4 READ + 1 READ_WRITE); no tutorial system reads it. All 5 callers are the four directional walk_step handlers (fd2_walk_step_down/left/right/up) plus fd2_cutscene_event_trigger (cutscene walk simulation), each calling it once per frame inside the 6-frame walk slide loop. The body purely selects a footstep SFX cadence (divisor + sfx id) per job/status-immunity, plays the footstep SFX on divisor-aligned frames, and increments the counter -- zero tutorial logic. Proposed name follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> and matches the plate's rename candidate. No address residue in old or new name.
purpose: Per-frame footstep SFX dispatcher ticked once per frame inside the 6-frame walk-step slide loop; selects a per-job/per-immunity cadence and plays the footstep SFX on divisor-aligned frames, advancing the cadence counter.
logic_summary: Copies the 29-byte per-job cadence-class table into a stack buffer. If fd2_check_char_status_immunity(char_idx) != 0 (flying/lifted) -> divisor 6, sfx 10. Else looks up job_tbl[runtime_char[char_idx].job_id - 1]: class 0 -> divisor 6, sfx 9; class 1 -> divisor 4, sfx 9; other -> divisor 9, sfx 11. If data_fd2_audio_walk_step_sfx_cadence_counter % divisor == 0, calls fd2_play_sfx_with_handle(data_fd2_audio_fdother_sfx_bank_buf_ptr, sfx_id, 1). Then increments the counter unconditionally.

params.name: char_idx
params.semantics: runtime_char array index of the walking unit; used to (a) query status immunity via fd2_check_char_status_immunity and (b) read runtime_char[char_idx].job_id for the per-job cadence-class lookup. Callers pass the walking unit's index each frame.
params.reason: src already names this param 'char_idx' (accurate, no address residue). Ghidra still shows the generic placeholder 'param_1', which needs a descriptive name. Proposing 'walking_char_idx' to match the plate signature line and make Ghidra param consistent with the documented role. Param rename is Stage-2-applied only; not applied here.

returns.semantics: No return value; side effects are the footstep SFX trigger and the cadence counter increment.
